purpose: Use authenticated same-nucleus RNA+ATAC to measure regulatory/chromatin support and RNA recoverability for an already frozen RNA target.

known_identity_defects.issue: demographic/region identity conflict consistent with possible pooled-lane label swap
known_identity_defects.rule: Handle prospectively; never repair after outcome inspection.

primary_analysis: Exclude the two conflicted donor labels from deciding qualification unless an independently authenticated correction predates outcome opening.
sensitivity: Retain conflicted genotype-defined donors only with conflicted demographic/region fields unavailable; sensitivity cannot rescue primary failure.
foundation_freeze_prerequisite: Target candidate, target geometry, rare-program definitions, query definition and selection rule must be frozen before deciding multimodal outcomes are opened.

teacher_views.T_RNA_ATAC: same RNA plus qualified same-nucleus ATAC/regulatory features

primary_quantities: Delta_privileged between RNA+ATAC and RNA teacher states

decision_states.R2_FAIL: sufficient support but no reproducible increment or shortcut-explained
decision_states.RNA_RECOVERABLE: privileged increment reproducibly predictable from RNA

nonrescue: Regulatory pass does not select foundation target.
Regulatory fail does not retrospectively redefine target.
non_authority_statement: No analysis executed and no target/TD60/Stage4/training authority granted.
